title: Research from scratch retries transient media failures and preserves history
steps: Run the shared-research PostgreSQL test with a failed image download, a stored image, a blocked URL and a revoked reference. Restore the downloader and request research from scratch twice.
expect: An ordinary forced refresh does not retry references.
Research from scratch downloads only the non-revoked download_failed URL and exposes its real PNG bytes.
Blocked and revoked media remain unchanged, old snapshot membership is unchanged, and stored bytes win over an older failed reference on the next run.
A failed reference that becomes URL_BLOCKED stays blocked on the next from-scratch run; a planned Tripadvisor source retries its failed media.
fence: planned-source transient-reference retry with immutable historical media

tests: from-scratch research recovers failed downloads without reviving blocked or revoked media
from-scratch Tripadvisor research retries its failed media downloads
